Name: Sap Begone
Author: katriex
Description:
[center]
Hi! I'm back with yet another random mod.
This mod is INCREDIBLY niche and I made it to fix a problem I've had with the game for ages: slimes giving me a shitload of sap that's useless. It just clogs up inventory space and annoys the hell out of me. Figured I'd go ahead and publish it for anyone else who has the same hatred of sap that I do.

Should be compatible with virtually anything, and it should work on all slime varieties.
[b]EDIT 8/6/25: 1.0.1 fixes tiger slimes[/b], I was a silly goose and had a patch for tiger slimes that wasn't actually doing anything.
Please update the mod if you're far enough in the game to encounter tiger slimes!

[/center]

Downloads.Description: Fixed tiger slimes, turns out I'm a silly goose and forgot to actually edit the sap drop out.

Manifest.Name: Sap Begone
Manifest.Description: Removes sap as a drop from slimes. Begone, foul sap!
Manifest.Author: katrie
